scenarios.name: Baseline: 3-Story Ductile RC Frame (Imperial Valley RSN0001, PGA=0.40g)
scenarios.description: Code-conforming reinforced concrete frame under strong ground shaking.

scenarios.name: Intervention A: Lateral Stiffness +20% (T0 reduced from 0.50s to 0.456s)
scenarios.description: Structural retrofit adding concrete shear walls or steel cross-bracing.

scenarios.name: Intervention B: Yield Strength +20% (Yield displacement uy increased to 12 mm)
scenarios.description: Reinforcement strengthening increasing moment capacity at beam-column joints.

scenarios.name: Intervention C: Added Supplemental Damping (zeta increased from 5% to 7%)
scenarios.description: Installation of supplemental fluid viscous dampers to dissipate seismic kinetic energy.

scenarios.name: Event Sensitivity: 2001 Bhuj Earthquake (Mw 7.7 Intraplate, PGA=0.40g)
scenarios.description: Severe intraplate Kachchh rift ground motion with high-energy long-duration wave packets.
